_comment: Template: Compare two RDF model files and report differences.
_how_to_use: Copy to your working directory. Fill in the paths. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar compare --config this-file.json
_when_to_use: Use to diff two versions of a CIM RDFS profile or two SHACL shape graphs. Reports added, removed, or changed classes, attributes, associations, and property values.
_note_fileA: First (reference) RDF file. Extension used for auto-detection: .ttl → SHACL comparison, .rdf/.xml → RDFS comparison.
_note_fileB: Second RDF file to compare against the first.
_note_compareType: Comparison algorithm: 'rdfs' (RDFS CIM profile), 'rdfs-cimtool' (CIMTool-generated profiles), 'shacl' (SHACL shape graphs), or 'auto' (detect from file-A extension, default).
_note_normalizeCimVersion: Rename the 'cim' prefix namespace in fileB to match fileA before comparing. Useful when comparing profiles that use different CIM versions (e.g. CIM16 vs CIM17) but are otherwise structurally equivalent.
_note_normalizeProfileNs: Rename the profile namespace in fileB to match fileA. Requires 'nsPrefix' to identify which namespace to normalise.
_note_nsPrefix: The namespace prefix to normalise when 'normalizeProfileNs' is true (e.g. 'eq', 'tp', 'ssh').
_note_output: Where to write the result. Use .xlsx for an Excel workbook, any other extension for CSV. If omitted, prints to stdout using the 'format' field.
_note_format: Stdout format when 'output' is not set. 'text' (table, default), 'json', or 'csv'. Ignored when 'output' is set.

_exit_codes.0: Files are identical — no differences found.
_exit_codes.2: Bad or missing input; command was not executed.
